thoughts: I love the way the town quietens down in the winter.
My paws feel quite steady today.
I hope the snowflake set brings people some joy.
Maybe I should bake something warm for the visitors later.
Pip is getting very good at finding lost buttons.
The 25th is coming up so fast!
I wonder what colors I should use for the next project.
It is a lovely day to be a cat.
